def build(p):
    # M5 hex nut (ISO 4032) and M5 bolt (ISO 4762) come from params
    af, nh = p.nut_af, p.nut_h
    R, tf, cb = p.knob_dia / 2.0, p.floor_t, p.bolt_clear_hole
    mo, pa, la, ll = p.insert_min_open, p.pocket_af, p.pocket_lead_af, p.pocket_lead_len
    H = max(p.body_h, tf + nh + p.bolt_head_h + p.head_top_clear)
    k = 2.0 / 3.0 ** 0.5                      # across-flats -> across-corners
    hex_c, lead_c = pa * k, la * k
    pk_h = nh + p.nut_top_clear
    pk_top = tf + pk_h
    mtop = pk_top + p.relief_wall

    s = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(R).extrude(H)                                  # Ø30 blank
    s = s.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=mtop)                          # mouth bore, opens up
             .circle(mo / 2.0).extrude(H - mtop + 1.0))
    s = s.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=pk_top - ll)                   # 0.8 lead-in hex
             .polygon(6, lead_c).extrude(ll + 1.0))
    s = s.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=tf)                            # press-fit hex pocket
             .polygon(6, hex_c).extrude(pk_h - ll))
    s = s.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").circle(cb / 2.0).extrude(tf + 1.0))             # far-side exit bore
    rc = R - p.flute_depth + p.flute_cutter_d / 2.0                              # scallop centres
    s = s.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=p.flute_z0)
              .polarArray(rc, 0.0, int(p.flute_n))
              .circle(p.flute_cutter_d / 2.0)
              .extrude(H - p.flute_z0 + 0.5))
    return s
